question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I was __very much surprised__ to see Mariam at the party.
solution:
The correct answer is "**astonished**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the word "astonished" can replace the underlined phrase.**

 
 
• **"Astonished" means ****feeling sudden and great surprise or amazement.**(आश्चर्यचकित)

 
 
• Example: The students were astonished to see the name of the topper.
 
 
 
 
 
• The word "astonished" is a more intense synonym for "surprised" and fits better in the given sentence.
 
• Thus, the sentence can be written as:
 
 
• ​I was astonished to see Mariam at the party.
 
 

​​Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (bowled) means to knock someone down with a ball in cricket or to surprise or amaze someone greatly. However, it does not fit well in the given sentence.
 
• Option 3 (stalked) means to pursue or approach stealthily or persistently, often with harmful intentions. It is not related to the meaning of the sentence.(पीछा)
 
• Option 4 (aghast) means filled with horror or shock. It is a synonym of "astonished" but is not the best fit for the given sentence.(भयचकित और विस्मित)
